Bravura.sizeNotes: A SMuFL music font spans four staff spaces per em by definition. Confirmed by the staff5Lines anchor (4.000).

Bravura Text.sizeNotes: Follows the SMuFL text-font convention of five staff spaces per em, so a point size is NOT interchangeable with a music face. Confirmed by the staff5Lines anchor (4.998).

Chaconne Ex.sizeNotes: A SMuFL music font spans four staff spaces per em by definition. Not available locally, so unverified by measurement.

Emmentaler.sizeNotes: A SMuFL music font spans four staff spaces per em by definition. MuseScore ships this font under the internal family name 'MScore', apparently to avoid colliding with a separately installed copy, and stores that name in score styles while showing the display name in its font menu. Its SMuFL metadata declares fontName 'Emmentaler'. Measured from that copy.

Emmentaler Text.sizeNotes: Sits on the music em scale at four staff spaces per em rather than the five used by Bravura Text, so a point size is interchangeable with its music face. 319 measurements against Emmentaler fall within 1% of this convention, versus 2 for five. MuseScore ships this font under the internal family name 'MScore Text', apparently to avoid colliding with a separately installed copy, and stores that name in score styles while showing the display name in its font menu.
